text:
Ivy: Quick capture from today's SummitHealth check-in — three product asks surfaced: per-route cost detail in CSV, embedding index refresh control, and clearer onboarding checklist for routing rules.

Rohan: Which one is the immediate risk to renewal?

Ivy: Per-route CSV is urgent. Finance can't reconcile charges to product teams. They said contract renewal depends on this report.

Tess: Do we have an example invoice from them?

Ivy: Yes, uploaded to the intake doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/intake/summit_0526. It shows aggregated rows by model only.

Marta: Quick triage: severity = renewal blocker, account count = 1 pilot, reproducible = yes. Recommend P0.

Rohan: Technical options: emit per-request CSV rows at ingestion, or generate a backfill CSV from logs for the pilot. Backfill is fastest.

Tess: SummitHealth is fine with a fast backfill as a stopgap. They want a permanent solution afterward.

CSBot: Ticket created -> SH-212: "per-route billing CSV for SummitHealth" (linked to intake).

Marta: Proposed timeline: backfill CSV in 48-72h, infra change to include normalized route_id in 2 sprints.

Rohan: I'll scope the backfill today. If logs include route_name we can pivot to CSV in ~1-2 days. If not, call for small data model change.

Tess: I'll prep a finance-facing explanation: sample rows, timezone handling, and rounding rules. Will share draft.

Ivy: Also captures embeddings issue: they reported stale results on an index that's updated weekly. They want a refresh on-demand or TTL. Will put as P2 for now.

Marta: Action items:
- Rohan: backfill + deliver CSV to SummitHealth (72h)
- Tess: finance doc (48h)
- Rohan + Eng: spike for permanent change (assign this week)
- Ivy: schedule renewal check-in after CSV delivery

CSBot: Reminder set -> follow-up on SH-212 in 4 days.

Rohan: Assigning to myself for the spike. Will post ETA in the ticket.

Ivy: Thanks team — I'll drop a short note to SummitHealth that we're on it and expect CSV in 72h.
